info.name: Listrak Cross Channel REST app-push-mobile-client-device Contact API

params.name: listId
params.description: Identifier used to locate the list.

params.name: subscriptionState
params.description: Identifier used to specify subscription state of the contacts to retrieve. Allowed values are `Subscribed` and `Unsubscribed`. The default value is `Subscribed`.

params.name: externalContactId
params.description: External contact ID provided by the client. If provided, only returns contacts with a matching external contact ID.

params.name: segmentationFieldIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of profile field IDs to retrieve. Up to 30 fields may be included.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Value indicating the page of data that's being retrieved. The default value is `Start`.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of data members to be displayed per page. The default value is `1000` and the maximum value is `5000`.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Inclusive start date that's being used to filter the data members. This applies to subscribe date when retrieving subscribed contacts. Applies to unsubscribe date when retrieving unsubscribed contacts.

params.name: endDate
params.description: Inclusive (exclusive when `useOriginalSubscribeDate` is `false`) end date that's being used to filter the data members. This applies to subscribe date when retrieving subscribed contacts. Applies to unsubscribe date when retrieving unsubscribed contacts.

params.name: useOriginalSubscribeDate
params.description: Whether the `startDate` and `endDate` use the contact's original subscribe date or the contact's most recent subscribe date. Only applies when `subscriptionState` is `Subscribed`. The default value is `true`.

items.docs: Returns the collection of contacts associated with the specified list.

params.name: listId
params.description: Identifier used to locate the list.

params.name: eventIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of event identifiers that should be raised after the contact is created or updated.

params.name: overrideUnsubscribe
params.description: Whether a contact in an unsubscribed state should be forced to a subscribed state. The default value is `false`.

params.name: subscribedByContact
params.description: Whether the subscribe was initiated by the contact. The default value is `false`.

params.name: sendDoubleOptIn
params.description: Whether a double opt-in email should be sent if a new contact is being created. The default value is `false`.

params.name: updateType
params.description: If updating an existing contact, the type of update that will be performed on any submitted profile fields. Allowed values are `Update`, `Append`, and `Overwrite`. The default value is `Update`.

params.name: newEmailAddress
params.description: If updating an existing contact, the contact's email address will be changed to this value. Provide the original email address in the `emailAddress` body field to select the existing contact.

items.docs: Creates or updates a contact on the specified list.

items.docs:
Creates and subscribes a new contact for a phone number if the contact does not already exist on the sender code.
This call will create a record of the contact as well as subscribe the contact to the list that was passed in the route.
Changes to segmentation fields apply to the contact across all sender codes.

params.description: Phone number for contact.

items.docs: Returns a contact for a phone number. The response does not include a list id. This call will only return the system and custom profile fields for a contact along with the opted out status.

items.docs:
Updates a contact's information for a phone number. 
This call will update the system fields, custom profile fields, and the opt-out status of a contact.
It is only possible to opt out a contact using this call; not opting them in to the sender code. 
If a contact is opted out, it is still possible to update the contacts system and custom profile fields.
Changes to segmentation fields apply to the contact across all sender codes.

items.docs: Creates and starts a new update import for the specified sender code. HTTP request body lengths of up to 250 MB are permitted. Because the `fileStream` field must be encoded in Base64, and because the remainder of the JSON payload is counted against the 250 MB limit, the effective maximum import file size is approximately 185 MB (195,000,000 bytes); therefore, only attempt to import files up to 185 MB (195,000,000 bytes) in size.
